user.title: Battery planner
user.description: Shadow mode: plans and simulates a battery against your real prices and consumption without controlling anything.

data.price_entity: Price sensor (buy price, Nordpool with raw_today/raw_tomorrow)
data.sell_margin: Margin before selling from the battery (kr/kWh)
data.sell_buffer_pct: Consumption buffer before selling from the battery (%)
data.fire_threshold: Temperature that counts as the fire burning
data.vvb_plan_entity: Water heater planner status sensor (reads its plan)
data.use_solar_forecast: Use the solar forecast from the Energy dashboard
data.spare_heat_kw: Power that may run on spare battery energy, e.g. heaters (0 = off)
data.spare_buffer_pct: Consumption buffer for spare battery energy (%)
data.phase_current_entities: Current sensors per phase (all three, optional)
data.phase_margin_a: Margin below the fuse per phase

error.three_phases: Select all three phases or none.
